description_en: Modifies basic attributes of an office site (formerly a workspace), such as its name and whether to grant users local administrative permissions on their cloud computers
description_zh: 修改办公网络（原工作区）的基本属性，例如办公网络名称、是否为使用云电脑的用户赋予本地管理员权限等
kebab_example: aliyun ecd modify-office-site-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --office-site-id cn-hangzhou+dir-8823980000 --desktop-access-type INTERNET --office-site-name test --need-verify-login-risk false --need-verify-zero-device false --enable-admin-access false --authority-host example-string --tenant-id example-string --domain-name example-string --client-id example-string --client-secret example-string --vswitch-id example-string --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyOfficeSiteAttribute

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html operation to query the regions where Elastic Desktop Service is available
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the office site
parameters.name: office_site_id

parameters.help_en:
The method for connecting to cloud computers.

VPC connections use Alibaba Cloud PrivateLink, a free service. If you set this parameter to VPC or Any, PrivateLink is automatically activated
parameters.help_zh:
连接云电脑时允许使用的接入方式。

VPC连接方式依赖于阿里云私网连接PrivateLink服务，该服务不收取费用。该参数设置为`VPC`或者`Any`时，系统将自动为您开通私网连接服务
parameters.name: desktop_access_type

parameters.help_en:
The name of the office site. The name must be 2 to 255 characters long. The name must start with a letter or a Chinese character, and cannot start with http\:// or https\://. It can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), and hyphens (-).
This parameter is optional.
parameters.help_zh:
办公网络名称。长度为2~255个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者短划线（-）。    
默认值：空
parameters.name: office_site_name

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable two-factor authentication. This parameter is applicable to only office sites that use convenience accounts. If enabled, the system performs a security check during logon. If the system detects a risk, it sends a verification code to the email address that is associated with the account. The user must enter the correct verification code to log on
parameters.help_zh: 仅适用于便捷账号办公网络，表示登录时是否需要二次验证。如果开启了登录二次验证，则便捷用户登录客户端时，系统将检测登录账号是否有安全风险。如果有风险，系统将发送验证码到该账号关联的邮箱，便捷用户使用验证码验证通过后才能登录客户端
parameters.name: need_verify_login_risk

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable device verification. This feature is available only for office sites that use convenience accounts
parameters.help_zh: 仅适用于便捷账号办公网络，表示是否开启设备校验。对于AD办公网络，该参数值为空
parameters.name: need_verify_zero_device

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to grant cloud computer users local administrative permissions
parameters.help_zh: 是否为使用云电脑的用户赋予本地管理员权限
parameters.name: enable_admin_access
